summary: Write DataView scalar values with width-specific conversion, bounds checks, and explicit endian semantics.

target.notes: Numeric integer setters use Number conversion plus width-specific modulo semantics; BigInt setters use ToBigInt and reject Number values.

tests.name: integer wrapping and endian
tests.input: const b=new ArrayBuffer(2); const v=new DataView(b); v.setUint16(0,0x1234); console.log([...new Uint8Array(b)]); v.setUint8(0,257); console.log(v.getUint8(0));

tests.name: bigint modulo
tests.input: const b=new ArrayBuffer(8); const v=new DataView(b); v.setBigUint64(0,(1n<<64n)+5n); console.log(v.getBigUint64(0));
